ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to freshmen and sophomores, not in FSHN, only. Meets first eight weeks. Lectures will be delivered via UIUC Compass (powerpoint with audio). DO NOT E-MAIL THE INSTRUCTOR FOR SPECIAL CONSIDERATION BEYOND THE WAITLIST POLICY.
